A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

A method for every mystery.

Choose a method, enter your message, and hit transform. To reverse it, switch to decrypt and use the same settings.

Classical ciphers are for learning and puzzles. Base64 is an encoding. For password-protected messages, choose AES-256-GCM and keep the password somewhere safe.

Your text and passwords stay in memory in this browser tab. Refreshing the page clears them.
